FlashInfer Trace
	

We provide an official dataset called FlashInfer Trace with kernels and workloads in real-world AI system deployment environments. FlashInfer-Bench can use this dataset to measure and compare the performance of kernels. It follows the FlashInfer Trace Schema.
It is organized as follows:
flashinfer_trace/   # Here
├── definitions/
└── workloads/

flashinfer-trace/   # On Hugging Face
├── solutions/
└── traces/

Example solutions and traces directories, featuring… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-trace.
